# QCT Commerce

> QCT Commerce builds and improves websites, e-commerce systems, search visibility and AI-supported digital growth infrastructure for businesses in Türkiye and selected international markets.

QCT Commerce provides corporate and personal websites, e-commerce setup and migration, website redesign, product operations, conversion-focused landing pages, SEO, GEO, AEO, AIO, analytics, WhatsApp sales systems and AI-supported business automation.

The primary market is Türkiye. The English section mirrors the Türkiye-focused service and knowledge scope for English-speaking residents, founders and teams operating in Türkiye. Dedicated international market-entry pages, such as Georgia, remain separate.

QCT Commerce is part of the wider QCT ecosystem. QCT Studio is a separate sister brand.

Verified contact information: info@qctcommerce.com; WhatsApp only: +90 545 678 26 55.

## English pages for Türkiye

The English section mirrors the Türkiye service scope for English-speaking residents, founders and teams operating in Türkiye. Prices remain in Turkish lira and local platform context is preserved.

- [English home](https://qctcommerce.com/en/): Same website, e-commerce, redesign, audit, migration and visibility scope with transparent TL pricing.
- [English services](https://qctcommerce.com/en/services/): Same core service scope as the Turkish section.
- [English pricing](https://qctcommerce.com/en/pricing/): Website, e-commerce, redesign, product entry and SEO/GEO/AEO/AIO prices in TL.
- [Shopify store setup](https://qctcommerce.com/en/shopify-store-setup/): Shopify setup and redesign for businesses in Türkiye.
- [ikas store setup](https://qctcommerce.com/en/ikas-store-setup/): ikas setup, redesign and migration.
- [WhatsApp sales systems](https://qctcommerce.com/en/whatsapp-sales/): Contextual enquiry, routing and follow-up systems.
- [Meta ads and landing pages](https://qctcommerce.com/en/meta-ads/): Campaign-to-conversion systems.
- [English blog](https://qctcommerce.com/en/blog/): English versions of QCT Commerce guides for Türkiye.
